1|project('libspng', 'c', version : '0.4.2', license : 'bsd', default_options : ['c_std=c99'])
2|
3|cc = meson.get_compiler('c')
4|
5|include = include_directories('src')
6|
7|zlib_dep = dependency('zlib')
8|m_dep = cc.find_library('m', required : false)
9|
10|spng_deps = [ zlib_dep, m_dep ]
11|
12|lib_src = files(['src/decode.c',
13|                 'src/common.c'])
14|
15|optimize_defilter = get_option('optimize_defilter')
16|
17|if optimize_defilter == true
18|    if host_machine.cpu_family() == 'x86' or host_machine.cpu_family() == 'x86_64'
19|        lib_src += files('src/filter_sse2_intrinsics.c')
20|        add_project_arguments('-DSPNG_OPTIMIZE_DEFILTER', '-msse2', '-mssse3',  language : 'c')
21|    endif
22|endif
23|
24|lib = library('spng', lib_src,
25|              dependencies : spng_deps,
26|              version : meson.project_version(),
27|              soversion : '0.4.2',
28|              install : true)
29|
30|spng_dep = declare_dependency(link_with : lib,
31|                              dependencies : spng_deps,
32|                              include_directories : include,
33|                              version : meson.project_version())
34|
35|example = executable('example', 'examples/example.c',
36|                     link_with : lib,
37|                     include_directories : include,
38|                     dependencies : zlib_dep)
39|
40|install_headers('src/spng.h')
41|
42|pkg = import('pkgconfig')
43|pkg.generate(name : 'spng',
44|             libraries : lib,
45|             version : meson.project_version(),
46|             description : 'PNG decoding and encoding library',
47|             libraries_private : [ '-lm', '-lz' ])
48|
49|dev_build = get_option('dev_build')
50|
51|if(dev_build)
52|    subdir('tests')
53|endif
54|

1|option('dev_build', type : 'boolean', value : false, description : 'Enable the testsuite, requires libpng')
2|option('optimize_defilter', type : 'boolean', value : true, description : 'Optimize defiltering, requires SSSE3 on x86')
